name: Albany
summary: New York's capital — a grand 19th-century statehouse and a modernist plaza that looks like the future imagined in 1965.

lodging.name: A downtown Albany hotel
lodging.blurb: Walkable to the Capitol and Empire State Plaza.

foodMustTry.name: An Albany 'mini' hot dog
foodMustTry.blurb: The local late-night specialty with meat sauce.

days.label: Day 94 — The Capital
days.summary: One of the most opulent state capitols in the country.

item.title: New York State Capitol
item.blurb: A châteauesque 1899 capitol with no dome and the hand-carved 'Million Dollar Staircase.'

item.title: Empire State Plaza & the NY State Museum
item.blurb: A vast modernist plaza with 'The Egg,' the Corning Tower observation deck, and the free state museum.

days.label: Day 95 — South into New Jersey
days.summary: Down past the city to the New Jersey capital.

commute.scenicNote: South down the Hudson corridor and around the city into New Jersey.
